intervention_names: Other: life style modification at base line

brief_summary: The hypothesis is, in subjects with persistent impaired glucose tolerance(IGT) , sitagliptin will decrease the conversion rate to diabetes as compared to a placebo in three years.
brief_title: Sitagliptin in Prevention of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Subjects with IGT in the age group of 30-55 years (n=900) will be identified by screening with a standard OGTT.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Known diabetes
2. Pregnant women
3. Alcohol abuse
4. Transferable jobs.
5. Subjects with major illness like cancer, hepatic or cardiac diseases.

interventions.name: life style modification at base line

lead_sponsor.name: India Diabetes Research Foundation & Dr. A. Ramachandran's Diabetes Hospitals

official_title: Does the DPP4 Inhibitor Sitagliptin Have a Role in Preventing Type 2 Diabetes- A Randomised Controlled Study.

primary_outcomes.measure: 1. Rate of conversion of IGT to diabetes. 2. Relative reduction of incidence of diabetes by Sitagliptin among people with IGT compared to Placebo. 3. Increase in reversal of IGT to NGT
